title: American Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty, crumbly sausage skillet dish that's perfect for a satisfying breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: assumed to be a cooking vessel

instructions: Cook the sausage in the skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the sausage is browned, remove it from the skillet and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it's translucent.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir them with the onion.
Add the cooked sausage back into the skillet and stir it into the eggs.
If using shredded cheddar, sprinkle it on top of the sausage and eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
